Dialog.NotImported: The guide has not been imported into this world yet.
Dialog.UpToDate: Your journals are up to date.
Dialog.Force: Also overwrite pages I have edited
Dialog.ForceHint: By default, a page you edited by hand is never replaced. Pages you add to the journals yourself are never touched.
Dialog.Credits: Guide written by DragnaCarta, free and not affiliated with Wizards of the Coast. Consider supporting their work on Patreon.

Notify.Done: Curse of Strahd: Reloaded: {created} pages created, {updated} updated, {removed} removed, {unchanged} unchanged.
Notify.Conflicts: {count} hand-edited pages were not updated. Run the import again with "Overwrite" checked to replace them.
Notify.UpdateAvailable: A Curse of Strahd: Reloaded update is available. Open "CoS Reloaded" in the Journal tab to apply it.
Notify.TranslationOutdated: {count} sections have no up-to-date translation and were imported in English.

CheckForUpdates.Name: Check for guide updates
CheckForUpdates.Hint: When the world launches, tells the GM if a new version of the guide has been published.

GuideLanguage.Name: Guide language
GuideLanguage.Hint: Language of the imported journals. Sections without an up-to-date translation stay in English. Run the import again after changing it.

TranslationUrl.Name: Translation location
TranslationUrl.Hint: Folder (relative to the Foundry Data folder) or URL holding the translation's manifest.json. Defaults to the French translation shipped with the module.
